observations.behavior: Removes a local composite action and replaces it with an external reusable GitHub Action. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F3.H1 show the complete removal of the local action definition. P1.F2.H1 and P1.F4.H1 show the replacement of the local action reference with an external one and the addition of required inputs.
observations.posthog_connection: This action resolves an error tracking release ID for the PostHog release, which is then baked into container images and used by the Python SDK to link backend exceptions to the release. P1.F4.H1 explicitly comments this connection: "This step must never block a deploy... An empty id is fine: the SDK treats a blank value as unset."

observations.behavior: Replaces the local action reference with an external reusable action and adds required inputs. P1.F2.H1 and P1.F4.H1 show the change from `uses: ./.depot/actions/resolve-error-tracking-release` to `uses: PostHog/resolve-release@52d3bea6f86a713545874057b7d4bfebb6b5f367 # v1.0.0`. P1.F4.H1 also adds `project-id: '2'` and `release-name: posthog` inputs.
observations.posthog_connection: This change moves the release resolution logic to an external, shared action, potentially improving maintainability and consistency across repositories. P1.F4.H1 adds the release-name and release-version inputs, which are required for the action to resolve the release correctly.
